dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part II
dialogues.text: "...The sonic catcher is constantly blaring. It almost reminds me of Fourrier Anton's old grandmother's snoring... We can't use it as-is..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part II
dialogues.text: "...I'm going to call it the 'Babushka,' I think. This issue might have been caused by the radiation from the crystal itself and the influence of that black matter..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part II
dialogues.text: "...I do not have the spare parts to repair the 'Babushka,' so it has to be disassembled. Sorry, grandma. Setting up camp here and awaiting resupply."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part II
dialogues.text: "...It seems that someone is observing us from a vantage point nearby. Spotted an unnatural flash. A telescope (or perhaps the scope of a rifle?) Either way, we have to move..."
